skills.name: rayden-compose
skills.description: Compose a complete Rayden UI screen in Figma as an isolated task. Use for full-page builds: dashboards, landing pages, auth screens, settings pages, data table views. Runs in a dedicated subagent with full Rayden context. Requires Figma MCP. Usage: /rayden-compose [screen-type] [style-mode] [figma-url]
skills.description_zh: 把完整Rayden UI界面组合作为独立任务，在原说明的专用子代理中构建仪表板、落地页、认证、设置或数据表视图，需连接Figma MCP并提供界面类型、风格及URL。
